h1: The Presentation in the Temple: Fourth Joyful Mystery
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Presentation in the Temple.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Fourth Joyful Mystery, the Presentation in the Temple: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on obedience and self-offering.
aboutHtml:
Painting: Andrea Mantegna, The Presentation. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Monday / Saturday.

faq.q: What is the Fourth Joyful Mystery?
faq.a: The Presentation in the Temple. Mary and Joseph carried the baby Jesus to the Temple in Jerusalem to present him to the Lord. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Monday / Saturday, and its fruit is obedience and self-offering.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
